text: Etobicoke York Community Council will introduce bills.

General Bills Etobicoke York Community Council passed By-laws 499-2025 to 502-2025, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006. Confirmatory Bill Etobicoke York Community Council passed a Confirmatory Bill as By-law 503-2025, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006.
